$comment: Project-level Claude Code settings for the UX visual-tweak Codespace flow. The agent may READ anything but may only WRITE to the visual surface (components + themes). It runs the typecheck/lint gates and opens a PR, but cannot touch the backend, generated OpenAPI types, CI workflows, or tests. See .claude/UX-TWEAK-GUIDE.md for the visual-only scoping the agent is expected to follow.
